settings-privacy.reason: Privacy here means who sees your personal details (the 'show my phone number' toggle). Shield-with-person says personal data is protected. privacy-tip reads as an info tip; shield-lock and lock read as security/password, and the lock is already used for protected-info.

settings-notifications.reason: Same bell as the house action/user-notifications, but at weight 400. The house file is weight 300 with a baked #464C55 fill, so beside the other 400-weight settings icons it reads lighter, as if disabled. action/notifications is a 1024-grid legacy glyph.

settings-manage-account.reason: Same glyph as the house user/manage-accounts at weight 400; the house file is drawn heavier (about 600) and is the darkest icon in the row.

settings-recommendations.reason: The toggle is 'recommendations based on your activity'. Sparkles are dubizzle's AI mark (misc/sparkle, gemini-stars), so they would promise AI. recommend-outline is a solid disc, the heaviest glyph in the list. Lightbulb means tips (listing-tip).

settings-offers.reason: The toggle covers communications as well as offers: updates, surveys, promotions. A megaphone covers both. A price tag reads as Sell/price on a marketplace; gift and loyalty-heart promise rewards that do not exist.

settings-logout-all-devices.reason: The row label carries the verb; the icon says 'all your devices'. Re-using the logout arrow would make it look like a duplicate of Logout. A crossed-out glyph reads as 'disabled'.

settings-delete-account.reason: Removes you, not a thing. The bin is already 'delete ad' (action/delete), so it would make deleting an account look as light as deleting a listing. no-accounts and person-off read as blocked/banned.

settings-show-phone.reason: Reused, found in the registry first. House icon; it is Material Symbols 'call' rounded, so it already matches. Used for the 'Show my phone number in ads' toggle.

settings-language.reason: Reused, found in the registry first. House icon (account menu 'Change language'). Translate glyph, kept rather than a globe so it stays the one the live menu ships.

settings-help.reason: Reused, found in the registry first. House icon (account menu 'Help & Support').

settings-logout.reason: Reused, found in the registry first. House icon (account menu 'Logout').

settings-entry.reason: Reused, found in the registry first. House icon (account menu 'Settings'). Material Symbols Rounded 400 at 20px; matches the set.
